biotools.summary: Assesses nucleotide sequence compatibility and translational bottlenecks across major bacterial, yeast, insect, and mammalian expression hosts. The software calculates geometric mean Codon Adaptation Index (CAI) scores, flags rare codon clusters that can induce ribosomal pausing, and analyzes positional GC distribution across codons. Researchers can screen for unwanted translational motifs and benchmark construct suitability across candidate host systems via an interactive web interface or programmatic client libraries.
